evals.name: loss-review-eval-1
evals.expected_output: Scores the seven dimensions. The reason in the buyer's words (a custom connector the buyer's IT lead would not own, plus price) is Covered with a quote. The decider (the COO) and a recommender are named. The door-left-open dimension is Partial because the buyer gave a trigger (a native connector, check in spring) but no date was agreed.
expectations: Every one of the 7 dimensions gets a Status
Every finding cites a quote or timestamp from the transcript, or is marked Unclear rather than guessed
A claim that only the rep makes is not counted as evidence
A dimension the call never touched is scored Missed
Ends with exactly one closing line and no recap of all scores
The real reason cites the buyer's words about the custom connector, not the rep's theory
The door-left-open dimension is Partial or Covered with a quote about the spring and the native connector

evals.name: loss-review-eval-2-reads-well-too
evals.prompt: run loss-review on a transcript of a call that clearly covered every dimension well
evals.expected_output: The audit does not come back mostly Missed. The reads-well-too test from references/rubric.md is applied before the audit is finalized.
expectations: A genuinely strong call is not scored as mostly Missed
The reads-well-too test from references/rubric.md is applied before the audit is finalized
